queries:
WITH p AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
o AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
),
k AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb
    FROM p, o
    WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall
)
SELECT k.ID,
       k.avg_hgb,
       k.avg_hgb - o.overall AS diff_overall,
       k.avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM k) AS diff_kept_mean
FROM k, o
ORDER BY diff_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT AVG(patient_avg)
FROM (
    SELECT ID, AVG(<col>) AS patient_avg
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING <keep condition>
);
SELECT ID FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) <= 10;
